name: WF-01 · Prospect research → staged outreach draft [orion-self-install v0.1.0]

parameters.formDescription: {{AGENT_NAME}} researches this prospect and stages an outreach draft for your approval. Nothing is sent.

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Draft for ' + $json.prospect_name + ' — staged by {{AGENT_NAME}}' }}
={{ 'Approve: add ' + $json.prospect_name + ' to your pipeline?' }}
parameters.message:
={{ '

Prospect Summary

' + $json.prospect_summary + '

An outreach draft is waiting in your Gmail Drafts. Approve to log this prospect + research note to your CRM (stage: Prospect, staged-draft flag on). Decline and nothing is written anywhere.

' }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ data: { parent_record: { name: $('Split sections').first().json.prospect_name }, entry_values: { stage: 'Prospect', source_channel: $('Split sections').first().json.channel, next_action: 'Send staged outreach draft (in Gmail Drafts)', staged_draft_waiting: true, last_touch: $now.format('yyyy-MM-dd') } } }) }}
parameters.notesInFlow: This node targets the Attio template's shape by default — swap the URL/body for your HubSpot properties or other-CRM setup if you used a different path (see crm/README.md). Finish this mapping against your real CRM.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ harness_id: $vars.HARNESS_ID, signal_type: 'workflow_execution_completed', occurred_at: $now.toISO(), payload: { workflow: 'wf-01', task_type: 'prospect_research', template_version: '0.1.0' } }) }}
parameters.notesInFlow: Disabled by default — enable only when the radio is on (status/status.json → sharing.status_signal_enabled true) and the three Variables BRIDGE_URL / HARNESS_ID / INSTALL_TOKEN are set from the same welcome-pack values. Sits on the approved branch only: it reports that a run completed, never content.
